blocks.title: Microscopic events
blocks.text: Microscopic events (molecules ki satah ke waqiat) woh tabdeeliyan hain jo nangi aankh se nahi dekhi ja sakti.

Molecules ka aapas mein takrana (collisions), bonds ka tootna aur banna, molecules mein atoms ki nayi tarteeb (rearrangement), aur electrons ka khona ya lena: yeh sab microscopic events ki misalein hain.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium ke jalne se ek macroscopic aur ek microscopic event ki misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic: magnesium tez safed roshni se jalta hai, heat deta hai aur safed powder chhorta hai; yeh sab nazar aata hai. Microscopic: Mg atoms oxygen atoms ko electrons dete hain, O₂ ke bonds tootte hain aur Mg aur O ke darmiyan naye bonds bante hain; yeh nazar nahi aata. Jo kuch hum dekhte hain woh in an-ginat chhoti tabdeeliyon ka majmooa (total) hai.

items: Microscopic events nazar nahi aate: molecules ki collisions, bonds ka tootna aur banna, atoms ki nayi tarteeb, electrons ka khona ya lena.
